messages:
nicole: Heads-up: sample-app users hitting schema validation errors when SDK retry triggers for function calls in jsonMode. Repro below.

nicole: Repro: `client.generate({ jsonMode: true, function_call: { name: 'track', data: { user: 'u1' } }, retry: { retries: 2 } })`. First attempt OK, retry sends `data` as a string.

ben: can you paste the outgoing http log when the retry happens? my suspicion is the retry logic re-serializes an already-serialized body.

nicole: trimmed log: OUT -> { path: '/v1/generate', body: '{"model":"r-1","function_call":"{\"name\":\"track\",\"data\":\"{\\\"user\\\":\\\"u1\\\"}"}" }' }

ben: yep double-stringified. Quick fix: when we enqueue the retry, store a deep clone of the request object (structuredClone / lodash), not the serialized string. Also ensure the middleware only stringifies right before fetch if body is not already a string.

qa-bot: test-suite: failing -> `sdk/retry.spec.ts` missing coverage for preserving nested object types for `function_call.data` across retries.

tara: agree with deep-clone + add unit + e2e sample-app test. Also add a short dev-only warning when `jsonMode && retry` to surface the issue until we publish a patch. Keep the warning behind DEBUG flag.

nicole: I'll open a PR with clone helper + guard + tests + sample-app quickstart note. Ben, can you review the fetch guard change?

ben: yup, will review. If you want pairing on tests I can help. :+1:
